title: project started: prove how the rule system behaves in a live session: injection, scope and runtime changes
what: created QUESTIONS.jsonl, TASKS.md, HISTORY.jsonl with rules.py init

title: rules are live: a new rule fires at once; an edited rule is not re-sent in the same session
result: Adapt's rule_router, fed the same tool calls a session makes: a rule and gate created mid-session fired on the first touch of its file, with no reload; not again in that session; never on a file outside its gate. After editing the rule, the session that already had it got nothing; a new session got the edited text. Cause: gates and rule text are read fresh on every tool call, but each rule is sent once per session (already_sent). Live in the AOE-started session the Adapt rule never arrived: hooks come from the project the session started in, and AOE's router skips any path outside AOE.
no_rule: a behaviour of the router, stated in repo/hooks and lifecycle docs

title: live in a session started here: a new rule arrives at once, and an edited one arrives again marked CHANGED
result: A headless Claude Code session started in Adapt (tests/probe/live_check.py) read the gated file and got PROBE-V2 with no reload; while it waited the rule was edited to PROBE-V3; its second read got V3 marked CHANGED. Confirms the router reads rules and gates fresh on every tool call, and the re-send on change works live.
no_rule: the router's behaviour, now stated in repo/rule-lifecycle, repo/hooks and rules/INDEX.md

title: router re-sends an edited rule; probe rule removed; live check made self-contained
result: rule_router.py and rules_lib now remember the text hash of each rule a session was sent and re-send a rule whose text changed, marked CHANGED (hook suite 131/0 with new checks). With the user's go-ahead the probe rule rules/tests/probe.rule.md and its gate were deleted; live_check.py now creates and removes its own probe, so the check can be rerun.

title: live check: a new rule, and an edited rule, reach the prompt with no reload
result: live-confirmed in a session started in Adapt: a rule created mid-session reaches the prompt on the first touch of its file, never outside its gate, and an edit reaches the same session again, marked CHANGED. No reload is ever needed.
